description_en: Retrieves a list of trending topics
name: ListHotTopics

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the business space
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en:
Filters the results by hot topic source. For a list of supported hot topic sources, call the `ListHotSources` operation.

`Aggregation`: represents the aggregated list of national hot topics
parameters.help_zh:
热榜源筛选，支持的热榜源。热榜源详见API：ListHotSources

Aggregation：表示 聚合后的全国热点话题榜
parameters.name: topic_source

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by hot topic
parameters.name: topics

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by data version
parameters.name: topic_version

parameters.example: 根据热榜主题全文检索
parameters.help_en: The keywords for a full-text search on hot topics
parameters.help_zh: 根据热榜主题全文检索
parameters.name: topic_query

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include news in the response
parameters.name: with_news

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. If you do not specify this parameter, the service returns the first page of results. You can get this token from the `NextToken` response parameter of the previous request
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return for a single request. If this parameter is not specified, the service uses a default value
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by a custom business field. The service performs an exact keyword match on this field. The value can be up to 255 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 自定义业务字段筛选（keyword 精确匹配），长度上限 255 字符
parameters.name: custom_field

parameters.help_en: The start of the creation time filter range (inclusive). The value must be in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.help_zh: 话题创建时间筛选起点（包含），格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the creation time filter range (inclusive). The value must be in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.help_zh: 话题创建时间筛选终点（包含），格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: create_time_end
